prompt.project_info: Create a hyper-realistic waist-up hallway mirror selfie of an approved adult East Asian woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult East Asian woman with long straight black hair, soft facial features, subtle makeup, and neutral gaze, wearing a white-and-navy striped ribbed camisole with secure coverage and green-blue plaid pajama pants, with a generic waistband and no visible branding.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical center-weighted waist-up mirror selfie, phone partially obscuring face and arm, light wooden door, white wall, thermostat/intercom panel, realistic slight grain.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm indoor overhead light creates gentle realistic shadows, authentic casual home-social-media mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Hyper-realistic iPhone-style smartphone photography, 8K-style detail, waist-up mirror framing, natural skin texture and slight mobile grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A hyper-realistic vertical waist-up mirror selfie of an approved adult East Asian woman with long straight black hair, soft facial features, subtle makeup, and a neutral gaze slightly away from the camera. She wears a white-and-navy thin-striped ribbed camisole with secure coverage and green-and-blue plaid pajama pants with a generic waistband and no visible branding. Her phone partially obscures her face and arm. The hallway or bathroom entryway includes a light wooden door, white wall, and digital thermostat or intercom panel. Use soft warm overhead lighting, realistic shadows, natural skin texture, slight mobile grain, and authentic social-media photography.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, visible branded waistband, exposed underwear, transparent camisole, deep neckline, sexualized pose, nudity, logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, hallway, hair, striped palette, plaid pants, mirror, and phone; replace the waistband with a generic unbranded equivalent. Keep typography and logos absent.

changes: Clarified approved adult, replaced visible branded waistband with a generic waistband, and required secure coverage without changing the casual hallway concept.
